criterion: Starting on the authenticated V4 launcher, the Dashboards card and its Open module control are visible.
steps_taken: Navigated to the V4 launcher and confirmed the authenticated welcome view.
Confirmed the Dashboards card is present with the visible Open Dashboards control.

criterion: After selecting Open module on the Dashboards card, the Dashboards module or its current placeholder is displayed and no application error is shown.
steps_taken: Confirmed the Dashboards page displayed its Under construction placeholder, heading, and explanatory copy with no application error.

criterion: After using the browser Back control from the Dashboards module or placeholder, the V4 launcher is displayed and the Dashboards card is visible again.
steps_taken: Started this criterion from the V4 launcher.
Opened Dashboards to establish the module state.
Confirmed the browser returned to the launcher and the Dashboards card was visible again.
